Kill [[Nulfastu, Earthbound]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Kill Nulfastu, Earthbound in [[Drakkar Lake]].
* *BONUS* Kill Nulfastu in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 5,000 [[Experience]]
* 1,000 [[Gold]]
* 1,250 [[Norn rank|Norn reputation points]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 30 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 75 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
See [[Nulfastu, Earthbound#Notes|Nulfastu, Earthbound]].
